Round 232 is planned and dispatched: **CALM-3**, the last stage of SABA-B-8 "Calm Studio". The decision is **CONTINUE**. Nothing in `store/` was touched (HEAD `e5507ff`, clean status, the frozen-file hashes still match).

**Round 231 outcome** (from C's report and the published root gate, not claims):
- C passed all 16 browser-run rows; `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are true. Gate 231 published `e5507ff`, which is the new baseline.
- CALM-2 is done, and RETRO 230 is closed (C-R230-01 fixed).
- GATE229-S3, GATE229-S5 and B-R229-DOC170-STATUS are closed.
- C's one new bug, C-R231-01 (Low), went to the deferred polish list: after a cancelled library drag, the drop ghost stays on the lane. It is the same root cause as the older C-R139-02, so one fix will close both.
- I ruled on A's open reviewer items and C's notes. I also recorded an error in my own round-231 task: it claimed Apply had an `aria-describedby`, and it doesn't. The code was right.
- Backlog is now v217, and `feature-status.md` is updated. The round-231 task is archived as `tasks/round-231.md`.

**Round 232 task:**
- **Empty Overview:** when the project has no clips, the Overview is a single quiet 1 px line under the video dock: no frame, no outline, no playhead, and the same size. The full view comes back with the first clip, and returns to the quiet line after an Undo to zero clips.
- **Ctrl+Alt+O (Cmd+Option+O on Mac):** hides or shows the Overview, as in the Live 12 manual §42.1. The choice is remembered in the browser, and a one-time status line confirms it. The keys:
  - work on the Georgian layout;
  - ignore AltGr, held keys, text fields, open dialogs and mid-drag;
  - add nothing to Undo.
- **Hidden state:** an empty 64 px space stays in place. My browser probe showed the video box sets the dock height, and without that space the video caption drops 68 px. Collapsing the dock row was not approved by Saba.
- **Shortcut sheet:** gains a new "Show / hide the overview" row.
- **Two small carried items:** GATE229-S2 (a class cleanup in the dock) and the GATE229-S4 caption-height check.

**Pre-checks I ran:**
- On a scratch copy outside the repo, the change turned 4 tests red in 3 files. All are now in A's grants. With the fixes, the swept set (122 files, 1,789 tests) passes and TypeScript is clean.
- Every browser recipe in the task was run on a scratch server at 1440×900 and 1280×720.

**Scope:**
- 8 granted files and 4 new ones.
- A copy of every other tracked file is frozen by hash, including the protected auth and purchase files.
- The `/studio-lab` purchase-protection check (anonymous access, sign-in required on `/studio/:id`, token 401) is an acceptance row.

The advisor was available, and I used it before planning and at handover. At handover it caught a real flaw: the reset I had prescribed for the new test file would have made the "stays hidden after reload" test impossible. I moved that test into its own file and checked on the scratch that it passes and catches the bug it targets.

**What comes next:**
- After C passes round 232, SABA-B-8 is complete. I filed a non-blocking architecture checkpoint request for root (`b-round-231-checkpoint-request.md`).
- Round 233 is a REGRESSION round if planning falls on or after 2026-10-30. Otherwise it is SABA-B-7, the clip-envelope dB curve. Then SYS-5, then the performance work.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
